title.narrative: 2026 oPt Emergency Appeal - West Bank - Education in Emergencies

description.narrative: UNRWA’s EiE programme will support 48,000 West Bank students whose education has been disrupted by violence, movement restrictions and trauma. The Agency will ensure access to education by providing transportation for 2,500 students and staff in violence-affected areas and repairing crisis-affected schools, including those in Beit Surik, Nur Shams, Tulkarm and Jenin camps. Learning recovery will include catch-up lessons and educational kits for 6,000 students impacted by school closures and other conflict-related disruptions. To address severe psychosocial needs, UNRWA will support 48,000 students through school counsellors and recreational teachers and engage 8,000 children in camps. The Agency will also strengthen safety and wellbeing by hiring additional classroom attendants, delivering safety awareness sessions to more than 28,000 children and implementing parent and community awareness initiatives to help vulnerable students maintain access to safe, quality education during the ongoing emergency.
